purpose: Follow-up after inspecting primary data, before supplementary injections or measurements. Retain primary results unchanged.
edge_spectra: Keep original sidebands whenever possible. If red anchors missing, supplement at +5600..+6300 km/s; if blue missing, -6300..-5400. Separate flags and calibration. Quantify all parent counts.
null: For each object set intrinsic core FWHM equal to its archived single Gaussian scale, preserving the measured correlation with line luminosity, source SNR and sampling. Inject a Gaussian, or add 5-35% flux in wings of triple core dispersion. Refit on empirical sideband block noise. Conditional template diagnostic only. Gaussian+absorption subset as in primary injection. At least 60 trials per high-SNR JWST source, 12 per SDSS source.
full_width_reference: Compute a noiseless +/-50000 km/s reference after instrumental convolution and absorption. Quantify how fixed windows compress natural scatter.
